definitions.explanation: A woody extension growing from the trunk of a tree.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{枝|えだ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{止|と}まっている→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: A bird is perched on a branch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{枝|えだ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{折|お}れて→折れる：01266_oreru⟧、⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ふさいでいた→塞ぐ：00046_fusagu⟧。
examples.english: A large branch broke off in the typhoon and was blocking the road.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小枝|こえだ}→小枝：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拾|ひろ}う→拾う：00845_hirou⟧。
⟦{子|こ}どもたち→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{小枝|こえだ}→小枝：noentry⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: The children are playing with twigs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地面|じめん}→地面：00125_jimen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ちていた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧⟦{細|ほそ}い→細い：02962_hosoi⟧{枝|えだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めて→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧、⟦たき{火|び}→焚き火：06992_takibi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I gathered thin twigs that had fallen on the ground and made a bonfire.

notes:
{枝|えだ} means branch, bough, or twig - woody extensions growing from a tree trunk.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {枝豆|えだまめ}: edamame (soybeans on the branch)
- {小枝|こえだ}: twig, small branch
- {枝葉|えだは}: branches and leaves; minor details
- {枝分|えだわ}かれ: branching, diverging

EXPRESSIONS:
- {枝|えだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to prune branches
- {枝|えだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧: to spread branches
- {枝|えだ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{止|と}まる→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧: to perch on a branch

IDIOM:
{枝葉末節|しようまっせつ}: trivial details (lit. branches, leaves, and twigs)
